title: Photo Share
summary: The spec builds Photo Share as an API and a web app.
architecture: Two leaves: repos/api serves /api/ and repos/web serves the app on port 3000.
interfaces: POST /api/albums creates an album and returns 201 with its id.
data_model: An album has an id, a name and an owner. A photo has an id, an album id and a file key.
acceptance_criteria: Creating an album returns 201. A missing album returns 404.
security: The server checks the owner on every write. No password is stored in clear text.
testing: Each leaf has unit tests. The acceptance run opens repos/web.

deviations.what: The design asks for a reset link by SMS.
deviations.why: The leaves have no SMS service, so the reset link goes by email.
